plan_ref.note: Best practices derived from the execution entry

subject: Best practices: MVP status UX without backend streaming (robust fallbacks + deterministic logs)

items.title: Prefer deterministic UI-side status stages when backend is buffered
items.rationale: If the backend does not stream, the UI still needs perceived-latency cues to prevent repeated clicks and confusion.
items.evidence: UI emits 'User message sent' -> 'Agent is thinking' -> 'Rendering response' -> 'Finished' even for JSON-only responses.
items.action: Keep status updates in the UI pipeline and treat backend streaming as an optional enhancement.

items.title: Log to a stable repo-level path (avoid cwd ambiguity)
items.rationale: Next dev servers can run from different working directories; relying on process.cwd() makes logs appear in unexpected locations.
items.evidence: Added diagnostics and ensured logs are written to a consistent repo-level log file.
items.action: Use resolved absolute paths for operational logs and expose a simple GET endpoint for path verification.

items.title: Remove deprecated UI stacks to reduce maintenance
items.rationale: Keeping multiple UI implementations increases confusion and breaks deterministic onboarding.
items.evidence: Shiny UI folder and Shiny-specific docs/scripts were removed.
items.action: Maintain a single supported UI path and keep docs pointing only to the active one.
